lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to chisel out two new stone tablets, and Moses carries them up Mount Sinai alone.
The LORD descends in a cloud and proclaims His name, and Moses bows down and asks Him to go with them.
The LORD promises to drive out the Amorites and tells Israel to make treaties with the people of the land.

wrong_details.wrong: tells Israel to make treaties with the people of the land
wrong_details.true: warns Israel not to make a treaty with the inhabitants of the land

lines.text: Moses stays with the LORD seven days and seven nights without eating bread or drinking water, and writes the Ten Commandments.
Moses' face is radiant when he comes down, so he puts a veil over it after speaking to the Israelites.
